title: Towards Optimism-Pessimism Trade-off in Model-based Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) enables sample-efficient adaptation by leveraging offline pre-training for online fine-tuning. However, the distribution shifts between offline and online stages often hinder fine-tuning performance. Many existing methods encode the optimism-pessimism trade-off through a single-objective formulation. Selecting its trade-off coefficient through online fine-tuning can require costly bi-level optimization. We identify the balance established during offline training as a key challenge: in our motivating experiments, optimistic policies adapt better to novel tasks, whereas pessimistic policies perform better on the same online tasks. To address this challenge, we propose a bi-objective formulation that captures this trade-off, yielding a Pareto policy pool during offline training. This policy pool enables adaptive selection during online fine-tuning across diverse online tasks. To gene

translated_title: 面向基于模型的离线到在线强化学习中的乐观-悲观权衡研究
translated_abstract: 基于模型的离线到在线强化学习（RL）通过利用离线预训练进行在线微调，实现了样本高效的适应。然而，离线与在线阶段之间的分布偏移常常阻碍微调性能。许多现有方法通过单目标形式来编码乐观-悲观权衡，而通过在线微调来选择其权衡系数可能需要代价高昂的双层优化。我们识别出离线训练期间建立的平衡是一个关键挑战：在我们的动机实验中，乐观策略能更好地适应新任务，而悲观策略在相同的在线任务上表现更好。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种捕捉这种权衡的双目标形式，在离线训练期间产生一个帕累托策略池。该策略池使得在线微调期间能够跨多种不同的在线任务进行自适应策略选择。
tldr: 该论文提出一种双目标形式化方法，在离线训练阶段构建帕累托策略池，使在线微调时能够针对不同在线任务自适应地选择策略，从而解决基于模型的离线到在线强化学习中乐观与悲观的权衡难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bi-objective formulation that yields a Pareto policy pool during offline training, enabling adaptive policy selection across diverse online tasks during fine-tuning to address the optimism-pessimism trade-off in model-based offline-to-online RL.
